response.sql: WITH fielding_by_hand AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.bats, 'Unknown') as batting_hand, COUNT(*) as count FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, 'Unknown')) SELECT batting_hand, count, count * 100.0 / SUM(count) OVER () as share, count - AVG(count) OVER () as above_average FROM fielding_by_hand WHERE count > (SELECT AVG(count) FROM fielding_by_hand) ORDER BY count DESC
